description: Which of the rep's own customers (marked on MedaRep) can open a door to a surgeon: partners now or before, the same hospital, the same device company, or a partner in common, with each path's strength. Give one NPI, or a family and a place for the territory's warmest targets and its lookalikes: surgeons who fit the pattern of the rep's customers there (setting, employment, volume, company), connected or not.

cities.description: Cities within the state, to narrow it.

counties.description: 5-digit county FIPS codes forming a custom territory.

family.description: Procedure family key from coverage (e.g. knee-arthroplasty, lumbar-fusion) or a plain name.

metro.description: Metro area by name ("Charlotte") or 5-digit CBSA code (16740). Can cross state lines.

npi.description: A target's 10-digit NPI. Omit to rank a territory's targets.

state.description: Two-letter state code, e.g. NC. Omit when giving a metro or counties.

zips.description: 5-digit ZIP codes forming a custom territory (as my_territories returns them).

title: Warm introductions
